scope: Source harnesses for isolated native-framework acceptance; never install over or reconfigure the shipping client. All URLs must address an owned loopback server with authorized qualification assets.

apple.run: Create a new simulator in an owned --set directory, boot, install the ad-hoc signed app; launch with SIMCTL_CHILD_QUAL_URL and SIMCTL_CHILD_QUAL_CASE. Read Documents/qualification.json from get_app_container data. Terminate between cases, remove the prior receipt, and accept only matching case identity. Shutdown/delete only that owned device in finally.

android.run: Create an owned Android TV API36 AVD with explicit temporary path. Boot with -no-window -no-snapshot -gpu swiftshader -cores 2 -memory 2048. Install app-debug.apk after every temporary-disk boot. Use adb reverse for the owned loopback server. Launch org.plurx.qualification.video/.ProbeActivity with --es url and --es case. Poll run-as files/qualification.json until valid JSON with matching case, bounded to105s: exec-out status alone does not prove file existence. Force-stop between cases and delete only the previous receipt. Kill and delete only the owned AVD in finally.

setup_failures_retained: Initial Android offline dependency resolution lacked transitive annotations; using the application plugin combination plus public dependency fetch compiled successfully.
Initial Android launcher treated exec-out status0 as proof of a file; its error text was not validJSON. No media verdict was obtained.
Owned AVD temporary disk did not persist APK across reboot; subsequent launches install explicitly.

Initial live-action bf0 probe attributed one outgoing14.583s decoder callback to the new backward-seek epoch with playerclock3s. Retained failure identifies a harness boundary; only this case is retried after target-epoch establishment.
